title: AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.32989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention costs $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in the number of tokens. Vector-quantized attention reduces this to $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ by clustering the $N$ keys, attending to the $M$ codewords instead, and its adaptive form, AVQ-attention, concentrates codebook resolution where a query's attention mass actually falls. We present AVQ-Attention-2, a better design that merges it with exact local attention and attends to the mean of each cluster's keys rather than to a codeword. We show three improvements: consistently better quality at comparable cost; training that now also costs $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ rather than $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$; and an approximation accurate enough that the layer can be dropped into a pretrained transformer without fine-tuning. Across a variety of sequence lengths the result is competitive not merely with other approximate attention but with exact dense attention, running faster than FlashAttention at little to no loss in quality.

translated_title: AVQ-Attention-2：具有精确局部块和线性成本训练的自适应向量量化注意力
translated_abstract: 注意力机制的成本随token数量呈 O(N²) 增长。向量量化注意力通过对 N 个键进行聚类、转而关注 M 个码字，将成本降至 O(NM)；其自适应形式 AVQ-attention 能够将码本分辨率集中在查询注意力质量实际所在的位置。我们提出了 AVQ-Attention-2，这是一种更优的设计，它将自适应向量量化注意力与精确局部注意力相结合，并关注每个聚类的键均值而非码字。我们展示了三项改进：在相当的成本下持续获得更好的质量；训练成本也降至 O(NM) 而非 O(N²)；近似精度足够高，该层可以直接插入预训练 Transformer 而无需微调。在各种序列长度下，其结果不仅能与其他近似注意力方法竞争，还能与精确稠密注意力相媲美，在几乎没有质量损失的情况下运行速度超过 FlashAttention。
tldr: AVQ-Attention-2 通过将精确局部注意力与关注聚类键均值的自适应向量量化注意力相结合，实现了线性成本的训练和推理，无需微调即可直接插入预训练 Transformer，在几乎无损的情况下运行速度快于 FlashAttention 且质量可与精确稠密注意力相媲美。
en_tdlr: AVQ-Attention-2 combines exact local attention with adaptive vector-quantized attention that attends to cluster means, achieving linear-cost training and inference, plug-and-play integration into pretrained transformers without fine-tuning, and quality competitive with exact dense attention while running faster than FlashAttention with little to no loss.
